yaml:
scenario: Diabetic_Ketoacidosis_Detection
version: 1.0.0
description: Detect diabetic ketoacidosis based on ADA criteria and stage severity
signals:
  Glucose:
    ref: plasma_glucose
    expected_unit: mg/dL
    description: Plasma glucose level
    concept_id: 3052381
    concept_code: 48986-4
    vocabulary_id: LOINC
  pH:
    ref: arterial_ph
    expected_unit: unitless
    description: Arterial blood pH
    concept_id: 3019977
    concept_code: 2744-1
    vocabulary_id: LOINC
  Bicarbonate:
    ref: serum_bicarbonate
    expected_unit: mEq/L
    description: Serum bicarbonate level
    concept_id: 607488
    concept_code: '1153484001'
    vocabulary_id: SNOMED
  AnionGap:
    ref: anion_gap
    expected_unit: mEq/L
    description: Anion gap
    concept_id: 4009397
    concept_code: '102637000'
    vocabulary_id: SNOMED
trends:
  glucose_current:
    expr: last(Glucose)
    description: Current plasma glucose level
  ph_current:
    expr: last(pH)
    description: Current arterial pH
  bicarbonate_current:
    expr: last(Bicarbonate)
    description: Current serum bicarbonate level
  anion_gap_current:
    expr: last(AnionGap)
    description: Current anion gap
logic:
  hyperglycemia:
    when: glucose_current > 250
    severity: medium
    description: Plasma glucose above 250 mg/dL
  acidosis:
    when: ph_current < 7.30
    severity: medium
    description: Arterial pH below 7.30
  bicarbonate_low:
    when: bicarbonate_current < 18
    severity: medium
    description: Serum bicarbonate below 18 mEq/L
  anion_gap_high:
    when: anion_gap_current > 10
    severity: medium
    description: Anion gap above 10 mEq/L
  dka_present:
    when: hyperglycemia AND acidosis AND bicarbonate_low AND anion_gap_high
    severity: high
    description: Diabetic ketoacidosis detected
  severity_mild:
    when: ph_current >= 7.25 AND ph_current < 7.30 AND bicarbonate_current >= 15 AND
      bicarbonate_current < 18
    severity: low
    description: Mild DKA
  severity_moderate:
    when: (ph_current >= 7.00 AND ph_current < 7.25) OR (bicarbonate_current >= 10
      AND bicarbonate_current < 15)
    severity: medium
    description: Moderate DKA
  severity_severe:
    when: ph_current < 7.00 OR bicarbonate_current < 10
    severity: critical
    description: Severe DKA
outputs:
  decision:
    has_dka:
      type: boolean
      from: logic.dka_present
      description: Patient has diabetic ketoacidosis
    severity_level:
      type: string
      from: (severity_mild OR severity_moderate OR severity_severe)
      description: Severity of diabetic ketoacidosis
  features:
    glucose_value:
      type: float
      from: trends.glucose_current
      description: Current plasma glucose level
    ph_value:
      type: float
      from: trends.ph_current
      description: Current arterial pH
    bicarbonate_value:
      type: float
      from: trends.bicarbonate_current
      description: Current serum bicarbonate level
    anion_gap_value:
      type: float
      from: trends.anion_gap_current
      description: Current anion gap
  evidence:
    timestamp:
      type: datetime
      expr: evaluation_time()
      description: When this evaluation was performed

details.matched_concept: Glucose [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma --8 AM specimen
